author: Kate King
title: Looking for artist for two character art pieces
content: I am looking for an artist who has avalibilty right now to draw two pieces of character art. Anyone have an opening? Recs from authors are very welcome. Human artists only, absolutely no AI. Bots and clearly AI content will be blocked. Please only comment below do not DM me. Update: One piece is 2 characters, the other is 3. Art for new unannounced book. Post examples of work in replies.

author: La Biblioteca Dracónica / maitespena
title: Se buscan ilustradores for character art (book promo)
content: 🚨Se buscan ilustradores 📢 Busco quien nos ilustre una serie de personajes, teniendo en cuenta que no todos serán humanos. Son imágenes para redes sociales, para promocionar nuestro libro. No para venderlas ni para ilustrar páginas. Sencillas, de personajes a solas o en grupo (se pedirán varias). Por favor, agradecería que añadierais vuestro portfolio y una lista de precios. También podéis escribirme en privado si lo preferís. Gracias. Adult novel with some demons/magical beings, humorous, colorful simple style.

title: Calling all artists for project
content: Calling all artists 👋 I’m putting together a project and urgently need to find a few artists who may be interested in collaborating. Please send me: — Portfolio — Art style/specialty — Commission rates — Current availability. I’m looking through submissions as they come in, so feel free to reach out even if you’re seeing this a little late. Thank you for helping spread the word!
